text: Human Rights Watch's 2026 world report records that police repression of protests in France restricted freedoms of expression and association, that the UN Committee Against Torture expressed deep concern over numerous allegations of excessive force and ill-treatment by law enforcement disproportionately affecting people of African and Arab descent and non-nationals, and that the European Court of Human Rights condemned France for racial profiling by police. CIVICUS rates French civic space 'obstructed'.
short: France: police repression of protests, excessive force and racial profiling documented
